# Wikipedia-English evaluation of Wikipedia training sweeps

Both curves use the existing Wikipedia-English component of Uncheatable, measured on a separate evaluation corpus. The full eight-point grid is available at both scales.

The epoch-matched proxy minimizes at 50% Wikipedia, 7.93789 realized epochs, and 1.3571734 BPB. Its 30% and 70% neighbors are worse by 0.00879576 and 0.01285538 BPB. The target minimizes at 70% Wikipedia, 11.09793 epochs, and 0.99084579 BPB. Its 50% neighbor is only 0.00335984 BPB worse; the 100% endpoint is 0.04594435 worse. These are single-seed observed grid minima. The earlier 7.94-epoch statement refers to the proxy.

The evaluation source is pinned in experiments/domain_phase_mix/tpp10_domain_sweeps_assets/evaluation.json: raw/uncheatable_eval/2026.06.28/wikipedia_english_20250901to20250914.jsonl.gz. Training uses separate Dolma v1.7 Wikipedia objects. This inspection establishes separate corpus provenance, not an article-level decontamination audit. The evaluation has 335 packed sequences, 685,745 scored tokens and 2,492,578 scored bytes.

The plot uses corrected BPB from the previously audited snapshot in plots_20260912/. It shows every point, without fitted curves, and uses separate y-axis ranges. Source hashes, epoch coordinates and raw values are retained in receipt.json and points.csv. A second reader independently reproduced both minima and neighbor gaps. The PNG was visually checked; lint and focused type checking pass. No training or evaluation jobs were launched.

Reproduce with `uv run python -m experiments.domain_phase_mix.plot_tpp10_wikipedia_evaluation`.
title: Wikipedia-English proxy and target curves
